name: Rendered Depth-Guided Warping
definition: A method to generate a warped image I_i->j from a source view I_i to an unseen target view j using rendered depth D_j and viewpoint difference R_i->j, enabling consistency regularization without full-resolution rendering.
summary: Rendered Depth-Guided Warping is a consistency regularization technique that uses low-resolution depth maps to warp source images for efficient geometric coherence enforcement during NeRF training.
